SELECT p.id, p.pet_no, p.name, p.category_id, pc.name AS category_name, pb.name AS breed_name, p.gender, p.age_month, p.cover_image, p.status, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adoption_application a WHERE a.pet_id = p.id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status IN ('SUBMITTED','REVIEWING','INTERVIEW','HOME_VISIT','APPROVED','SIGNED')) AS active_application_count, DATE_FORMAT(p.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time FROM pet p LEFT JOIN pet_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id AND pc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pet_breed pb ON pb.id = p.breed_id AND pb.deleted = 0
p.deleted = 0 AND p.shelter_id = #{shelterId} AND p.status = #{q.status} AND p.category_id = #{q.categoryId}
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.pet_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.update_time DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT p.id, p.pet_no, p.name, pc.name AS category_name, pb.name AS breed_name, p.gender, p.age_month, p.cover_image, p.status, p.shelter_id, s.name AS shelter_name, s.city, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, DATE_FORMAT(p.publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS publish_time, DATE_FORMAT(p.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time FROM pet p LEFT JOIN pet_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id AND pc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pet_breed pb ON pb.id = p.breed_id AND pb.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shelter s ON s.id = p.shelter_id AND s.deleted = 0
p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = #{q.status} AND p.category_id = #{q.categoryId} AND s.city = #{q.city} AND p.shelter_id = #{q.shelterId}
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.pet_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC
